narration: They started calling it the 3:03 case. Every night, all over the city, people get out of bed and walk. Same minute. Same direction. They don't answer you. They don't wake up. Last Tuesday it was forty-one of them. I mapped every route we had — they all end at the same empty field off Route 9. Tonight I followed them myself. I used to think nothing in this city could keep me up at night. Now I'm standing at a fence I don't want to cross, wondering who's calling them.

shots.prompt: Detective Aras Kaya (charcoal overcoat, loosened tie, tired eyes) sits at his desk in the lamplit precinct office at night, rubbing his eyes over a spread of case files, then pins a photo of a sleeping man onto the crowded evidence board. Slow push-in. Ends on: Aras staring at the board.

High wide angle down a suburban street at 3 AM: a dozen people in pajamas and nightclothes walk barefoot along the middle of the road in the same direction, evenly spaced, arms loose, faces blank and eyes closed, through pools of orange sodium light and thin ground fog. Slow, silent, unhurried. Ends on: the walkers receding into the dark.

A front door of a small house opens by itself and an elderly man in striped pajamas steps out barefoot, eyes closed, and joins the line of sleepwalkers passing on the street without breaking their rhythm. The door stays open behind him. Ends on: his empty doorway glowing faint warm light.

Detective Aras Kaya (charcoal overcoat, loosened tie) pins red strings across a large city map on the evidence board, each string tracing a route; the strings all converge on one empty spot at the map's edge. He steps back slowly, string spool in hand. Ends on: the converging strings filling the frame, Aras out of focus behind.

Detective Aras Kaya (charcoal overcoat) sits in his parked unmarked car at night, watching through the side window as sleepwalkers pass. One walker — a woman in a nightgown, eyes closed — stops beside his window for a moment, head tilting slightly, then walks on. Aras does not move. Ends on: Aras's tense face in the window reflection.

Wide shot at the edge of the vast moonlit field: the line of sleepwalkers files silently through a gap in the sagging wire fence and spreads into the knee-high grass and mist. Detective Aras Kaya (charcoal overcoat) stands at the fence in silhouette, not following. Ends on: Aras small against the enormous dark field.
